ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity (black) pixels along the perimeter and in localized surface marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous field covering both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated as a solid band along the trailing edge and terminal tips. Secondary low-intensity clusters (spots and lines) are distributed across the mid-lateral white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle is approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serration; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher amplitude peak-to-valley pixel variations compared to the more linear boundary of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the notch toward the distal tips, following a clear mathematical curve on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Approximately 6-8 discrete circular and ring-shaped low-intensity pixel clusters distributed across the central-white sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of dark, high-contrast linear marks; notably two parallel vertical lines on the left lobe and multiple shorter, unaligned diagonal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks and circular depression scars visible across both lobes; irregular fragmentation (notching) visible on the extreme right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-tan chromatic shift (staining) near the lower central base of the fluke where it joins the peduncle.
